title: Label Taxonomy
description: Provenance label taxonomy for the Control Tower (Part 3 §3.8, Part 2 §2.14). Seven labels with a total preorder (strength order), weakest-of rule for derived data, and the ALLOW-eligible set. P03 generates kernel types from this file.

strength_order.description: Total preorder: higher rank is stronger. SIMULATED_RULE and SYNTHETIC are tied at the same rank.

weakest_of_rule: A derived datum takes the weakest label of its inputs (minimum rank). When ranks are equal, any of the tied labels may be returned; the implementation must be consistent.
note: A SECONDARY-or-weaker datum in a Decision yields ABSTAIN, never ALLOW (Part 3 §3.8). SIMULATED_RULE and SYNTHETIC are equal in strength and are not ALLOW-eligible.
